recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一團黏聚的大型細胞，細胞質大量淡藍到深藍、邊緣模糊，核大、圓至橢圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁，核大小不一，與周圍模糊的紅血球背景相比明顯是非造血來源的上皮細胞團，符合骨髓轉移性腺癌。
features: Cohesive cluster of about a dozen large cells with overlapping, poorly defined borders (arrow)
Large round to oval nuclei with moderate size variation, finely granular chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale to deep blue, somewhat frothy cytoplasm with ragged edges
Small dark blue irregular bodies overlying several nuclei, most likely platelets or stain precipitate rather than mitoses
Few background hematopoietic cells; eyepiece photograph with blurred background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large cells with abundant basophilic, frothy cytoplasm, overlapping borders and large round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate anisonucleosis. Small dark bodies overlying several nuclei likely represent platelets or precipitate. These cells are distinct from normal marrow elements in size and cohesion. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; immunohistochemistry on the biopsy is recommended to confirm and to suggest the primary site.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts show uniform eccentric nuclei with a pale Golgi zone away from the nucleus and lack anisonucleosis.
Histiocytes have smaller bean-shaped nuclei with vacuolated cytoplasm containing debris or hemosiderin.
Sarcoma cells are usually less cohesive, may be spindled or multinucleated and are keratin negative with lineage-specific markers.
Cells may cluster but have horseshoe-shaped hallmark nuclei and are CD30/ALK positive and keratin negative.
